summary: MOBILE E2E on Letters flow. HEADLINE FIX VERIFIED on mobile: draft-a-letter from an invoice finding navigates to /letters/{id} and the editor auto-drafts with `lf1-carried-issues` populated (title 'ISSUES CARRIED OVER FROM INVOICE CHECKER' + the finding narrative pulled through) and NO 422 'Need a little more info' / `lf1-missing-fields` shown. rca of the issue: The primary user-reported bug ('Draft a letter opens a blank editor with a 422 error') is FIXED on mobile per the E2E screenshot. Root cause was the backend letter-bridge creating entries with intake={} → LF-1 /generate returned 422 source_data_missing → mobile editor rendered lf1-missing-fields ('Need a little more info first…'). Backend fix in /app/backend/routes/invoices.py now populates intake with participant_name / escalation_summary / subject / provider_name / recipient_name / prior_attempts at bridge-creation time; on mobile, lf1-carried-issues renders immediately and lf1-missing-fields is NOT shown. Remaining 502 from /generate is an unrelated transient LLM/gateway timeout, not the intake bug.
